frontier.hypothesis: A legitimate copy-preference can bias base->$a1 (or a2local->$a2) without adding dead refs, flipping the RA tiebreak on the double-reuse floor-9 chassis to reach byte-0.

A source structure that routes base through a copy/move preferring $a1 — or gives a2local a $a2 preference — would steer the color without the forbidden dead-op ref-padding.
